questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Algiers?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Algeria is Algiers.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Algeria about 2,381,741 square kilometres; Egypt about 1,010,408 square kilometres; Morocco about 446,550 square kilometres; Slovakia about 49,034 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Algeria?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Algeria on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Algeria article.

questions.proof: It is situated along the Mediterranean Sea with its borders being Tunisia, Libya, Niger, Mali, Mauritania, Western Sahara and Morocco.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Algeria on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Algeria on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Algeria?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Algeria article.

questions.proof: It has its capital and largest city as Algiers, which is in the far north.
